description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Specifications" name="Airplane specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements" name="Manufacturing requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BarParts" name="Configured bar parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OtherParts" name="Other configured interior parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AirplaneDelivery" name="Airplane delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Luxury Airplane Production" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SpecificationsReceived" name="Specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to manufacturing teams" messageRef="Message_Requirements">
      <bpmn:documentation>Manufacturing examples stated in the description: the Russian team manufactures a vodka bar, and the Irish team manufactures a whiskey bar.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" name="Manufacture configured parts in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveBarParts" name="Receive configured bar parts" messageRef="Message_BarParts"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOtherParts" name="Receive other configured interior parts" messageRef="Message_OtherParts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin" name="All configured parts received"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Conduct test flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProtocol" name="Create test protocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer" messageRef="Message_AirplaneDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DeliveryConfirmation" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P01" sourceRef="Start_SpecificationsReceived" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P02" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P03" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBarParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P04" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOtherParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P05" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveBarParts" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P06" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOtherParts" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P07" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P08" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Task_TestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P09" sourceRef="Task_TestFlight" targetRef="Task_CreateProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P10" sourceRef="Task_CreateProtocol" targetRef="Task_SendProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P11" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P12" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P13" sourceRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmation" targetRef="End_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer Specifications and Confirmation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseSpecifications" name="Choose airplane specifications">
      <bpmn:documentation>Choose among five different bars, and specify the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets. The base model remains the same.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSpecifications" name="Send specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProtocol" name="Receive test protocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAirplane" name="Receive delivered airplane" messageRef="Message_AirplaneDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm delivery" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Confirmation sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C01" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C02" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications" targetRef="Task_SendSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C03" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C05" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C06" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Airplane producer" processRef="Process_Producer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ManufacturingTeams" name="Manufacturing teams"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Send specifications" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Start_SpecificationsReceived" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Requirements" name="Send manufacturing requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Participant_ManufacturingTeams" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BarParts" name="Return configured bar parts" sourceRef="Participant_ManufacturingTeams" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBarParts" messageRef="Message_BarParts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OtherParts" name="Return other configured interior parts" sourceRef="Participant_ManufacturingTeams" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOtherParts" messageRef="Message_OtherParts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TestProtocol" name="Send test protocol" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AirplaneDelivery" name="Deliver airplane" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" messageRef="Message_AirplaneDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Confirm delivery" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmation" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
